title: Blue Jays erupt for 5 runs in the eighth to beat Red Sox 6-4, extend Boston’s skid to 5
author: The Associated Press
bullets: Toronto Blue Jays scored five runs in the eighth inning to defeat the Boston Red Sox 6-4.
Willson Contreras hit his 24th home run, but Boston matched its longest losing streak of the season.
Blue Jays' win was supported by Kazuma Okamoto's RBI single and Myles Straw's two-run double.

title: Allston-Brighton residents divided over future of Jackson Mann Community Center, survey shows
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: Survey shows Allston-Brighton residents divided on future of Jackson Mann Community Center redevelopment options.
553 residents responded; 190 favor housing, 171 favor a school, and 124 favor both housing and a school.
Mayor Michelle Wu to decide on redevelopment by year-end; construction not expected until 2030.

title: Tour the Patriots’ new 160,000-square-foot training facility
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: The Patriots' new 160,000-square-foot training facility is the largest in the NFL dedicated solely to football.
Key features include a 15,000-square-foot weight room and a 10,500-square-foot virtual reality room for game simulations.
The facility houses football offices, meeting rooms, and a dining area, and includes a fully equipped player lounge.

title: Man killed in stabbing inside South Station during rush hour, officials say
author: Madison Lucchesi
bullets: A man was fatally stabbed at South Station in Boston during rush hour on Wednesday evening.
The victim, unidentified by police, sustained at least one stab wound and died at a local hospital.
Police are searching for a male suspect, with investigations focusing on video evidence and witness interviews.

title: Body found at TD Garden, police say
author: Madison Lucchesi
bullets: Boston police found a deceased person at 100 Legends Way, TD Garden, on Wednesday around 5:15 p.m.
The body was located in or near the parking garage adjacent to TD Garden, according to preliminary information.
The investigation into the circumstances of the death is ongoing, with police handling inquiries about the incident.

title: Athol man charged with child pornography possession
author: Madison Lucchesi
bullets: Kristopher Ambrozewicz, 35, from Athol, charged with possession of child pornography, prosecutors said.
Search of Ambrozewicz's home resulted in seizure of several electronics and child abuse material, officials reported.
Ambrozewicz, a youth soccer referee, faces possible 20-year sentence and will be arraigned in Worcester Federal Court.

title: Police: Person held pregnant woman hostage with gun during dramatic chase on I-93 in Milton
author: Madison Lucchesi
bullets: A pregnant woman was held hostage at gunpoint during a police chase on I-93 in Milton.
The suspect, Dominic Hampton-Boyd, crashed into eight vehicles before being captured on foot near exit 11.
Hampton-Boyd is in custody and will be arraigned in Quincy District Court on multiple charges.

title: Stoughton town manager contradicts police chief who accused him of tampering with Sandra Birchmore investigation
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: Stoughton Town Manager Thomas Calter denies police chief Donna McNamara's tampering allegations in the Sandra Birchmore investigation.
Calter disputes McNamara's claim that he pressured her to resign and accuses her of making baseless harassment allegations.
Police Chief McNamara filed a lawsuit accusing Calter of discrimination and pressuring her resignation, while Calter awaits investigation results.

title: Nearly 30 people arrested after investigation into drug trafficking in Western Mass.
author: Madison Lucchesi
bullets: 28 people arrested in drug trafficking investigation in Chicopee, Holyoke, and Springfield, Mass.
Authorities seized over 1 kg of cocaine, fentanyl pills, heroin, and more than 12 firearms.
Operation led by FBI's Western Massachusetts Gang Task Force and Chicopee Police Department.

title: Patriots stock watch 2.0: Who’s rising and falling ahead of preseason opener?
author: Khari A. Thompson
bullets: Romeo Doubs and Eli Raridon are showing strong performances, enhancing their chances for significant roles with the Patriots.
Reserve cornerbacks struggled during joint practices, highlighting depth issues in the Patriots' secondary.
Behren Morton didn't practice with the team; he may play in the upcoming preseason game to improve standing.
